products.name: Wand
products.description: A Chrome extension for guided UDOIT and Canvas accessibility remediation.

products.name: Magic
products.description: A Windows application for accessible document review and repeatable team workflows.

products.name: Sorcerer
products.description: A server and web dashboard for submitting, tracking, and completing longer-running jobs.

wandCapabilities.name: Open the matching Canvas source
wandCapabilities.description: Moves from a UDOIT review item to its Canvas editing context and identifies the target when UDOIT provides enough information.

wandCapabilities.name: Styled heading remediation
wandCapabilities.description: Guides reviewers from visual heading styles to semantic Canvas headings.

wandCapabilities.name: Nondescript link cleanup
wandCapabilities.description: Turns filename-like link labels into cleaner suggestions without silently saving them.

wandCapabilities.name: Color-only communication review
wandCapabilities.description: Finds the affected content and offers an explicit non-color cue for reviewer approval.

wandCapabilities.name: Filename-based image alternative text
wandCapabilities.description: Cleans filename-based labels while leaving the final description and save decision to the reviewer.

wandCapabilities.name: Video caption review
wandCapabilities.description: Opens caption sources and supports UDOIT status rechecks for automatic, missing, or unverifiable captions.

wandCapabilities.name: Heading, table, list, link, and image guidance
wandCapabilities.description: Provides issue-specific reviewer guidance and safe actions across the current non-file UDOIT test suite.

wandCapabilities.name: Progress, diagnostics, and feedback drafts
wandCapabilities.description: Shows action progress, reports failures visibly, and saves copyable bug reports or suggestions on the device.
